overview: West Vancouver had 44,122 residents in the 2021 Census, growth of only 3.9 percent since 2016, in 17,690 occupied homes across 87.18 square kilometres. The median household income was $104,000 in 2020, well above the regional median.

Spending power is high, but the customer base grows slowly and expects quality. Park Royal draws regional shoppers, while village centres such as Ambleside, Dundarave and Horseshoe Bay serve neighbourhood trade. Local firms win by earning trust and repeat business.
